title: better-auth 1.5.5 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability in…
description: better-auth versions 1.5.5 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5 contain a privilege escalation vulnerability in the organization plugin. The flaw arises because the creator role check compares the raw invitation role string, while subsequent checks trim whitespace. This allows an attacker with invite permissions to submit a padded role string (e.g., " owner") that is accepted as an owner role upon invitation acceptance. Exploitation can lead to deletion of the organization and removal of original owners.
